question: Which part of the plant grows under the soil? 🌱
explanation: Great job! The roots grow deep under the soil to drink water for the plant! 🪢
hint: They keep the plant fixed firmly in the ground.

question: Which part holds the plant straight and tall? 🎋
explanation: Awesome! The stem works like a strong backbone to hold the plant up straight! 🎋
hint: It carries water up to the leaves.

question: What is the beautiful and colorful part of a plant? 🌺
explanation: Super! Flowers are very colorful and smell so sweet! 🌺
hint: Bees and butterflies love to visit it.

question: What colour are most of the leaves on a plant? 🌿
explanation: Great job! Most leaves are green and they look very fresh! 🌿
hint: It is the colour of grass.

question: What does a beautiful flower turn into? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! When flowers grow big, they turn into yummy fruits! 🍎
hint: It is sweet and juicy to eat.

question: What hides inside a yummy fruit? 🌰
explanation: Super! Fruits keep the little seeds safe inside their tummy! 🌰
hint: You plant this in the soil to grow a new plant.

question: What do we call a very big and tall plant? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Very big, tall, and strong plants are called trees! 🌳
hint: It gives us lots of shade.

question: What do plants need to drink to stay alive? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Plants get very thirsty and love to drink fresh water! 💧
hint: It comes from rain.

question: What do plants get from the bright sun? ☀️
explanation: Super! The sun gives plants bright light and warmth to help them grow! ☀️
hint: It shines in the day.

question: What is the thick, woody stem of a tree called? 🪵
explanation: Great job! The thick, strong, brown stem of a tree is called a trunk! 🪵
hint: Elephants have something with the same name.

question: Which small, bushy plants have woody stems? 🪴
explanation: Awesome! Shrubs are bushy plants that are smaller than trees! 🪴
hint: A rose plant is an example.

question: What do we call small plants with soft, green stems? 🌿
explanation: Super! Herbs are cute little plants with very soft stems! 🌿
hint: Mint and coriander are examples.

question: Which plants need a stick or wall to climb up? 🪜
explanation: Great job! Climbers have weak stems and need a strong friend to climb on! 🪜
hint: They climb high up.

question: Which plants grow and spread along the ground? 🍉
explanation: Awesome! Creepers have heavy fruits so they just creep on the ground! 🍉
hint: Pumpkins grow on them.

question: Where should we plant a new tiny seed? 🌱
explanation: Super! Soil is like a cozy bed where seeds can wake up and grow! 🟤
hint: It is the brown dirt on the ground.

question: Which of these is a lovely red flower? 🌹
explanation: Great job! A rose is a beautiful flower that smells amazing! 🌹
hint: It has soft red petals.

question: Which fruit has one very big seed inside it? 🥭
explanation: Awesome! A sweet, juicy mango has one big, hard seed inside! 🥭
hint: It is the king of fruits in summer.

question: What do we call a very young baby plant? 🌱
explanation: Super! When a seed first pops out, it is called a little seedling! 🌱
hint: It has 'seed' in its name.

question: What sweet thing do bees collect from flowers? 🍯
explanation: Great job! Flowers have sweet juice called nectar that bees love to drink! 🍯
hint: It helps make honey.

question: Which huge tree gives us sweet green coconuts? 🥥
explanation: Awesome! Coconut trees are very tall and grow near the beach! 🥥
hint: It is very tall and has large leaves at the top.

question: What falls from the trees when the wind blows? 🍂
explanation: Super! Old leaves fall from the branches to make room for new ones! 🍂
hint: They dry up and turn brown or yellow.

question: Which of these is a heavy fruit that grows on a creeper? 🍉
explanation: Great job! Watermelons are too heavy, so they grow safely on the ground! 🍉
hint: It is green outside and red inside.

question: Which pretty insect helps flowers in the garden? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! Butterflies fly from flower to flower and make the garden happy! 🦋
hint: It has colorful wings.

question: Which part makes food for the whole plant? 🍃
explanation: Super! Green leaves act like a tiny kitchen and cook food for the plant! 🍃
hint: It is flat and green.

question: Which of these is a climber plant? 🧗
explanation: Great job! A money plant climbs up nicely if you give it a stick! 🧗
hint: It has the word 'Money' in it.

question: Which tool do we use to give water to small plants? 🚿
explanation: Awesome! A watering can gently sprinkles water like soft rain! 🚿
hint: It has a spout with tiny holes.

question: What protects the soft inside of a tree trunk? 🪵
explanation: Super! Bark is the rough outer skin of a tree that keeps it safe! 🪵
hint: Dogs make a sound with the same name.

question: What is the very first step to grow a plant? 🌱
explanation: Great job! Every big plant starts by putting a tiny seed in the soil! 🌱
hint: You put it under the mud.

question: What gives trees a big, leafy umbrella shape? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Branches stretch out like arms to hold lots of green leaves! 🌳
hint: Birds sit on them.

question: Which beautiful flower grows in water? 🪷
explanation: Super! The Lotus is a wonderful pink flower that floats on the water! 🪷
hint: It is the national flower of India.

question: Which soft, green plant covers the ground in parks? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Grass is a small herb that makes a soft green carpet for us to play on! 🌾
hint: Cows love to eat it.

question: What do plants give us that helps us breathe? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! Plants clean the air so we can take nice, deep breaths! 🌬️
hint: You cannot see it, but you breathe it.

question: Which bright yellow flower always looks at the sun? 🌻
explanation: Super! A sunflower turns its face to smile at the warm sun all day! 🌻
hint: Its name has 'sun' in it.

question: Which of these is a healthy vegetable we get from a plant? 🥕
explanation: Great job! Carrots are healthy, crunchy roots that we can eat! 🥕
hint: Rabbits love to eat it.

question: What color is the inside of an apple? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! An apple has a shiny red skin but is sweet and white inside! 🍎
hint: It is the color of milk.

question: Where do birds love to build their nests? 🪹
explanation: Super! Trees give birds a safe and cozy home up in the branches! 🌳
hint: It has lots of green leaves.

question: Which part of the plant holds it tight against strong winds? 🪢
explanation: Great job! Strong roots grip the soil tightly so the plant won't fall down! 🪢
hint: They live under the ground.

question: Which of these is a yummy red fruit? 🍓
explanation: Awesome! Strawberries are red, sweet, and have tiny seeds on the outside! 🍓
hint: It is shaped like a little heart.

question: Which small, green herb do we put in our tea when we have a cough? 🌿
explanation: Super! Tulsi (Holy Basil) is a wonderful herb that keeps us healthy! 🌿
hint: It is also called Basil.

question: Which part of the plant grows down away from the sun? 🪢
explanation: Great job! Roots dig deep down into the dark soil to find water! 🪢
hint: They grow underground.

question: What happens to a little seed when you water it every day? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! With love and water, a tiny seed grows into a beautiful plant! 🌱
hint: It gets bigger.

question: Which fruit comes in a bunch and can be green or purple? 🍇
explanation: Super! Yummy grapes grow on climbers called grapevines in big bunches! 🍇
hint: They are small, round, and very sweet.

question: How should we treat plants and trees? 💖
explanation: Great job! Plants are our green friends and we must always love and protect them! 💖
hint: Give them water and care.

question: Which juicy fruit is known as the king of fruits? 🥭
explanation: Awesome! The delicious yellow mango is called the king of fruits! 🥭
hint: We eat it in the summer.

question: What carries food and water to all parts of the plant? 🎋
explanation: Super! The stem works like a long delivery pipe for the plant's food and water! 🎋
hint: It connects the roots to the leaves.

question: Which part of the plant has soft, colorful petals? 🌷
explanation: Great job! Flowers have bright, soft petals to invite friendly bugs! 🌷
hint: It makes the plant look pretty.

question: Which shape are most leaves? 🍃
explanation: Awesome! Leaves are flat so they can catch a lot of sunlight to make food! 🍃
hint: They are thin like paper.

question: Which of these things does a plant NOT need to grow? 🧸
explanation: Super! Plants don't play with toys, they just need sun, soil, air, and water! 🧸
hint: You play with these.

question: What do we call a small plant grown in a pot inside the house? 🪴
explanation: Great job! Houseplants make our rooms look fresh and beautiful! 🪴
hint: It has 'house' in its name.

question: Which plant has sharp thorns to protect itself? 🌵
explanation: Awesome! A cactus grows in hot places and has thorns to keep safe! 🌵
hint: Be careful, it is very prickly!
